items.title: Dr Hasmah, In Retrospect — Dr Loshi Rajen
items.summary: There is an old photo of Dr Hasmah driving a red Proton Saga across the Penang Bridge. The first car I ever knew was my father's Saga. Years later, looking through these photos, I would see her behind the wheel of one and feel a moment of borrowed pride.
